correctness.rationale: The claim specifies full Mallows(q) permutations, q>0, without endpoint sentinels; P and A count interior patterns of length three. Standardization of contiguous windows preserves Mallows weights and disjoint windows are weakly independent after conditioning on unordered value sets. The five overlapping lags t=-2,-1,0,1,2 have precise inversion-enumerator covariances; summing with (n-4,n-3,n-2) multiplicities gives q[(n-3)U(q)-V(q)]/H(q), with H positive and U degree eight, V positive coefficientwise. Independent exact weighted enumeration checked n=3..6 at q=1/2,1,2,3 and reproduced the formula (16 exhaustive n,q checks). The inspected CHECK.py additionally specifies a polynomial-in-q identity for the two affine-in-n coefficients; it was read, not treated as a log proving itself. Descartes signs on (n-3)U-V yield one positive root r_n for n>=4, the next-order substitution gives r_{n+1}<r_n, and Taylor expansion at the unique simple U-root gives rho and first-order displacement. n=3 has strictly negative covariance. Finite tests do not establish the infinite parameter claim; the sign argument does.
